args:
set -eu
if [ "$1" = legacy ]; then exec codex app-server; fi
[ "$1" = isolated ] || exit 1
sharedHome=${CODEX_HOME:-"$HOME/.codex"}
mkdir -p "$sharedHome"
sharedHome=$(cd "$sharedHome" && pwd -P)
umask 077
case "$(uname -s)" in
  Darwin) dataHome="$HOME/Library/Application Support/Buzz" ;;
  *) dataHome="${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/buzz" ;;
esac
mkdir -p "$dataHome/codex"
privateHome=$(cd "$dataHome/codex" && pwd -P)
if [ "$privateHome" = "$sharedHome" ]; then
  echo "Buzz's Codex store must differ from the shared Codex home" >&2
  exit 1
fi
for name in config.toml auth.json AGENTS.md rules skills; do
  target="$sharedHome/$name"
  link="$privateHome/$name"
  if [ ! -e "$link" ] && [ ! -L "$link" ]; then
    ln -s "$target" "$link" || true
  fi
  if [ ! -L "$link" ] || [ "$(readlink "$link")" != "$target" ]; then
    echo "Buzz's Codex setup conflicts with $link" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
done
exec env CODEX_HOME="$privateHome" codex app-server -c "sqlite_home=$privateHome"
